title: Pair additional iPhone users to a Lasso device
body:
Additional users can pair to and use the same Lasso device for an in-app purchase.

The in-app purchase can be made by either the existing user or the new user. Existing users can make the purchase by navigating to the Lasso app’s Settings > Device menu. New users can make the purchase by attempting to pair to the device.

Once a ‘seat’ is purchased on a device, it is valid for the life of the device and is not tied to a specific iPhone. If a device has two seats, any two iPhone users can be paired to it at once. They may also unpair from the device to free up space for someone else.
